draw.confirmation48_rationale: Fixed before candidate selection for 600s CPU feasibility based on prior large-model runtime, not performance.
draw.selection: One fixed text/ID-only SHA256 ranking; first8 DEV,next16 confirmation; no label/outcome/length stratification or redraw.

fitting.confirmation_use: Scorer/auditor only after frozen candidate/source/gate approval; no worker receives labels/text for candidate selection.

history.basis: Fresh restored immutable epoch8 registry and USED_IDENTITIES, exact source fulltext hashes and sourcegroup IDs; old raw corpus need not be present for redraw.

hypotheses.nda-17: Receiving Party may create a copy of some Confidential Information in some circumstances.
hypotheses.nda-3: Confidential Information may include verbally conveyed information.
hypotheses.nda-7: Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some third-parties (including consultants, agents and professional advisors).

inference_boundary.allowed_record_projection: input only: state full agreement and questions decision typed positive hypothesis/fixed not-established negation
inference_boundary.forbidden: gold, source annotation/evidence spans, IDs, provenance, role and selector metadata

limitations: Public-source project novelty only; fuzzy/document-version overlap, unknown historical provenance and model pretraining contamination not ruled out.
scope: Internal project-unused public original ContractNLI NDA pilot; not a sealed test, full LegalBench162 result or official JevBench Capability score.
scoring: Binary choice exact Yes iff source Entailment, elseNo; original threeway labels retained separately. No scoring performed by data worker.
statistical_unit: Source document group; retain all3 predicates together when bootstrapping16 confirmation groups.
